newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle bid $103.00, passed - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle bid $103.00, passed - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle bids near midday Tuesday at $102.00 to $103.00 per cwt on a dressed basis were passed by owners pricing cattle at $105.00, market sources said.
About 200 black steers that likely to grade 70 percent choice sold at $104.00, but the sale was called too light for a market test, sources said.
Sales last week were mostly at $105.00 to $106.00 in heavy trading, which likely gave packers enough cattle to get through most of this week's slaughter, sources said.
